notes: Rare F1 is the unweighted mean correct-subtype F1 of the configured guard and focus classes.
Role names do not imply the same attack semantics on different datasets; actual class names are recorded.
Five paired group splits overlap in data; sample SD describes these draws, not independent datasets.
Alarm recall detects any attack; subtype recall requires the correct attack label.
Thresholds are the frozen upper-99% calibration-normal order statistic with strict score > threshold.
No CE/balanced variant is selected on test outcomes; all predeclared arms and failures remain visible.
MAT-PV AP/ROC use its preserved graph alarm score; subtype heads do not invent new class probabilities.
Class-stratified capped cohorts do not estimate deployment prevalence or natural-traffic precision.
Fit costs exclude shared annotation/acquisition except MAT-PV overlaps its own tree50/graph cost; report both.
TabICL fit means context registration and excludes external checkpoint pretraining.
TabICL first calibration inference may build its representation cache; setup reporting includes that time, and deployment bytes include external weights.
